import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0 or len(data) < 2:
        return
    
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    
    expected_sum = n * (n + 1) // 2
    actual_sum = sum(arr)
    
    missing = expected_sum - actual_sum
    print(missing)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
